description: This file contains the implementation of the UserService interface for OpenMRS, including methods for user management such as creation, retrieval, updating, password management, role and privilege handling, and activation key functions. It also includes logic for security, locale handling, and interaction with data access objects (DAOs).

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the UserService interface that manages user entities, roles, privileges, password resets, and activation processes within the OpenMRS platform. It includes security checks, role management, email notifications, and interaction with the database via DAO.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with a specified password, ensuring no duplicate usernames or system IDs, and checks for required privileges.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their internal user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches a user entity based on username.

methods.name: hasDuplicateUsername
methods.description: Checks if a username or system ID is already in use.

methods.name: getUsersByRole
methods.description: Returns a list of users assigned a specific role.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user in the database, after verifying privileges and duplicates.

methods.name: retireUser
methods.description: Marks a user as retired and records the retire reason.

methods.name: unretireUser
methods.description: Reactivates a previously retired user.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Fetches all user entities from the database.

methods.name: getAllPrivileges
methods.description: Retrieves all privileges defined in the system.

methods.name: getPrivilege
methods.description: Retrieves a privilege by name.

methods.name: purgePrivilege
methods.description: Deletes a privilege unless it is a core privilege.

methods.name: savePrivilege
methods.description: Saves or updates a privilege.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Lists all roles in the system.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Fetches role details by role name.

methods.name: purgeRole
methods.description: Deletes a role if it is not a core role and has no child roles.

methods.name: saveRole
methods.description: Creates or updates a role, ensuring inheritance constraints.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the password of the current authenticated user.

methods.name: changeHashedPassword
methods.description: Updates a user's password using a hashed value and salt.

methods.name: changeQuestionAnswer
methods.description: Modifies the secret question and answer for a user.

methods.name: isSecretAnswer
methods.description: Verifies if a provided answer matches the user's secret answer.

methods.name: getUsersByName
methods.description: Searches users by given and family names.

methods.name: getUsersByPerson
methods.description: Fetches users linked to a specific Person object, optionally including retired users.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Searches for users with optional name filtering, role filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: setUserProperty
methods.description: Sets a custom property for a user.

methods.name: removeUserProperty
methods.description: Removes a custom property from a user.

methods.name: generateSystemId
methods.description: Generates a unique system ID for new users based on the Luhn checksum algorithm, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: purgeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from the database.

methods.name: changePasswordUsingSecretAnswer
methods.description: Allows a user to change their password after successfully answering their secret question.

methods.name: getSecretQuestion
methods.description: Retrieves the secret question associated with a user.

methods.name: getUserByUsernameOrEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user by username or email address.

methods.name: getUserByActivationKey
methods.description: Retrieves a user linked to a specific account activation key, validating expiry.

methods.name: setUserActivationKey
methods.description: Assigns an activation key for password reset, sends email notification.

methods.name: getDefaultLocaleForUser
methods.description: Fetches the preferred locale for a user, defaulting to system locale.

methods.name: changePasswordUsingActivationKey
methods.description: Allows password change via valid activation key.

methods.name: getLastLoginTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last login for a user.
